incident_title: Pack thermal shutdown on Copper Elm Node
suspected_root_cause: Cooling fan stopped during a sustained discharge.
confirmed_root_cause: Cooling fan bearing seizure caused a real pack temperature rise and a THERM-201 protective shutdown.
impact: DEV-001 went offline after pack temperature climbed from about 34 C to about 73 C.
mitigation: Pack left offline. Temperature threshold was not raised.
permanent_fix: Replace cooling fan CMP-0003 and recommission DEV-001.

incident_title: Heartbeat session drops after 4.3.0
confirmed_root_cause: Firmware 4.3.0 drops healthy sessions when one-way latency exceeds 120 ms. 4.3.1 restores the 4.2.1 heartbeat timing.
impact: Five devices raised COM-214 after the 15 Sep 4.3.0 window. Signal strength did not fall.
mitigation: 4.3.0 rollout halted. Two devices rolled back to 4.2.1. One gateway upgraded to 4.3.1.
permanent_fix: Move remaining 4.3.0 devices to 4.3.1. Do not deploy 4.3.0.

incident_title: Inverter power capped by a mismatched limit
suspected_root_cause: Inverter Power Limit left at 75 kW against the expected 90 kW.
confirmed_root_cause: A field edit set Inverter Power Limit to 75 kW. The approved expected value is 90 kW. Restoring 90 kW cleared the repeated INV-360 faults.
impact: Afternoon discharge on the Limestone Yard inverter flatlined near 75 kW from 14 Sep through 17 Sep.
mitigation: Power limit restored to 90 kW on 18 Sep.
permanent_fix: Require an engineering change before a field edit to Inverter Power Limit.

incident_title: Gateway link loss after signal collapse
confirmed_root_cause: Gateway radio path failed. Latency rose and signal strength fell together, then the gateway went offline. Firmware remained 4.2.1.
impact: DEV-025 stopped reporting at 2026-09-25 02:00 after RSSI fell past -100 dBm.
mitigation: Site dispatched for antenna and radio replacement. Neighboring gateways on 4.3.0 were not part of this path failure.
permanent_fix: Replace the gateway radio module and re-aim the antenna.

incident_title: HW-C cell imbalance at three sites
suspected_root_cause: Shared HW-C power-module busbar torque issue.
confirmed_root_cause: HW-C power-module busbar torque below spec causes cell-group voltage imbalance under discharge above 70 kW.
impact: BAT-204 recurred at three sites on HW-C packs during similar late-day discharge.
mitigation: Discharge on the three packs capped at 60 kW until the busbars are re-torqued.
permanent_fix: Re-torque the HW-C busbar and add the torque check to the HW-C installation guide.

incident_title: False thermal warnings from a drifting pack sensor
suspected_root_cause: Temperature sensor drift rather than a real pack heat rise.
confirmed_root_cause: The pack temperature sensor drifted high over four days and snapped back to about 28 C when it was replaced. Cooling and current were normal.
impact: False THERM-110 warnings. The pack stayed online. This is not the Copper Elm thermal shutdown.
mitigation: Ignored the high channel after the redundant channel stayed normal, then replaced the sensor.
permanent_fix: Replaced CMP-0210 with CMP-0216.

incident_title: Sudden inverter power collapse
suspected_root_cause: Power module or gate driver failed while the grid stayed nominal.
confirmed_root_cause: Inverter power module failed. Output fell from about 78 kW to 6.5 kW in one 20-minute sample while grid frequency stayed near 60 Hz and the DC bus sagged.
impact: DEV-043 remains faulted. The site lost the evening discharge.
mitigation: Site transferred the evening discharge to the utility feed.
permanent_fix: Replace the inverter power module. Waiting on the replacement part.

incident_title: Unexpected SOC step with no confirmed cause
suspected_root_cause: Unconfirmed hypotheses: SOC estimator bias, current-sensor offset, or standby parasitic load. None confirmed.
confirmed_root_cause: Under Investigation
impact: DEV-045 reported SOC fell by about 50 points at 03:20 on 21 Sep while current and power stayed near zero at that sample.
mitigation: Discharge power limited to 40 kW while the investigation continues. No part has been condemned.

incident_title: Contactor opened during discharge
confirmed_root_cause: Contactor coil driver failed. Coil current stayed at zero while the close command was present.
impact: The pack opened the main contactor during a routine discharge and stayed offline until repaired. No thermal alarm and no firmware change in the prior 7 days.
mitigation: Pack left open until the driver was replaced.
permanent_fix: Replaced the contactor coil driver.

incident_title: Contactor opened during discharge
confirmed_root_cause: Precharge resistor was open. The main contactor correctly stayed open because DC bus voltage did not rise. Coil current was present.
impact: The pack opened the main contactor during a routine discharge and stayed offline until repaired. No thermal alarm and no firmware change in the prior 7 days.
mitigation: Pack left open until the precharge resistor was replaced.
permanent_fix: Replaced the precharge resistor.

incident_title: Inverter latched after a grid frequency excursion
confirmed_root_cause: Grid frequency reached 61.28 Hz. The inverter protection latch held output at zero after frequency returned to 60 Hz.
impact: Evening discharge at Lantern Field did not run. The inverter is still faulted.
mitigation: Leave the latch set until a supervised reset. Do not replace the power module for this event.
permanent_fix: Supervised reset after the grid trace is archived.

incident_title: Proactive watch: early signals on three online systems
suspected_root_cause: No failure yet. Early signals only: flat elevated temperature, slowly rising latency, and repeated short watchdog restarts.
impact: None of the three devices is offline or faulted. The signals are below trip thresholds.
mitigation: Watch list only. Do not roll a firmware image or replace hardware on this evidence alone.
